name: Simple Coming Soon
author: Ssebuwufu Moses

sections.description:
Simple Coming Soon is the easiest way to hide your site from visitors while you work on it. We believe essential features should be free, not locked behind a paywall.

New in Version 1.4: Design Freedom & Smart Features! We have completely rebuilt the plugin to include Pro-level design controls (Shadows, Borders, Glassmorphism) and smart logic (Auto-Launch Timer, Secret Access).

🔥 Key Features:

  • Pro Action Button (New): Add a Call-to-Action (CTA) button with full design control. Customize Hover Colors, Border Width, Padding, and more.
  • Shadow Presets (New): Instantly apply professional shadow styles (Soft, Medium, Retro, Deep) with one click.
  • Smart Countdown: Display a beautiful, responsive countdown clock.
  • Auto-Launch Mode: Automatically publish your live site when the countdown ends. (Great for launching while you sleep!)
  • Secret Bypass Link: Share a unique “Magic Link” (e.g., /?secret=clientview) to let clients see the site without needing a user account.
  • Frosted Glass Effect: Adjust opacity and blur to create a modern Apple-style “Glassmorphism” look.
  • Full Design Control: Upload full-screen background images, change colors, and adjust rounded corners.
  • SEO Friendly: Sends a proper 503 HTTP status code to notify search engines to check back later.

Usage

1. How to Design the Action Button:
* Go to the Action Button section.
* Enter your text (e.g., “Join Waitlist”) and URL.
* Use the Button Design area to set hover colors, border width, and select a Shadow Style (Soft, Medium, Hard, Deep).

2. How to use the Countdown Timer:
* Scroll to the “Countdown Timer” section.
* Check “Enable Timer” and select your Launch Date/Time.
* Optional: Check “Auto-Launch” if you want the site to automatically go live when time runs out.

3. How to use Secret Client Access:
* Enter a simple word in the “Bypass Keyword” field (e.g., demo).
* Click Save.
* Copy the generated link and send it to your client. They can now see the live site!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simple-coming-soon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Coming Soon to configure your page.
  4. Click “Save Settings” and your custom page is live immediately.
sections.faq:
Q: I activated the plugin, but I can still see my website. Is it broken?

A: No! The plugin intentionally lets you (the logged-in admin) see the site so you can work on it. Please check the site in an Incognito/Private window to see the Coming Soon page.

Q: How do I create a “Ghost Button” (Transparent with border)?

A: Easy! In the Action Button settings:
1. Set “Background Color” to Transparent.
2. Set “Border Width” to 2px.
3. Set “Border Color” to White.
4. Set “Shadow Effect” to None.

Q: Does the Countdown Timer automatically publish the site?

A: Yes, BUT only if you check the “Auto-Launch” box in the settings.

Q: How long does the Secret Client Link last?

A: For security, the secret link uses a “Session Cookie.” Access lasts as long as the browser window remains open. Once the client closes their browser, the access is revoked.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Massive Update: The “Pro” Release
  • New: Advanced Action Button with Hover, Border, Padding, and Shadow controls.
  • New: Smart Countdown Timer with Auto-Launch mode.
  • New: Secret Client Access (Bypass Link) logic.
  • New: “Frosted Glass” design engine (Blur & Opacity).
  • Improved: WCAG Accessibility compliance for social icons and focus states.

1.3.1

  • Feature: Added a Settings Page (Settings > Coming Soon).
  • Feature: Added Logo Upload capability.
  • Feature: Added Customizable Headline and Message fields.
  • Feature: Added Social Media icons (Facebook, X, Instagram).
  • Style: Complete visual overhaul with modern gradient background and animations.
  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 6.9.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Removed global <body> styling that caused the plugin to cover site headers and sections.
  • Fixed: Ensured the coming soon page displays correctly without breaking the site layout.
  • Improved: Wrapped content in a dedicated .scs-wrapper for safer styling.
  • Improved: Added responsive design with mobile-friendly font sizes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
